stage: Stage 1 - source inspection and access-path inventory

solved: Inspected parent Django/DRF settings, resource upload/download, risk authorization contracts, quota service, audit service, and database selection.
Confirmed the parent repository remained read-only and the isolated task directory did not previously exist.
not_solved: Runtime production proxy, storage ACL, database routing, and deployed authentication configuration were unavailable.

findings.claim: Existing resource download is authenticated but is not evidence of controlled delivery completion.

evidence_refs.observation: Download count and learning event are updated before response transmission can be observed as complete.
evidence_refs.supports: A separate delivery state model is required.
evidence_refs.does_not_support: It does not prove any deployed download bypass.

findings.claim: Risk authorization, quota, and audit capabilities exist as separate parent modules.

evidence_refs.observation: Separate contracts and persistence/services are present.
evidence_refs.does_not_support: These modules are not integrated with this isolated service.

approved_decisions: All parent files are read-only; implementation is isolated under tasks/controlled-export-execution.

open_questions.resolution_needed: Provide deployed proxy, storage ACL, identity, and database topology evidence.

next_stage_constraints: Do not change parent public contracts, schema, dependencies, or file routes.
authorization_remaining: Isolated implementation and synthetic tests only.

stage: Stage 2 - contracts, state machines, and change design

solved: Separated execution, attempt, artifact, share, delivery, idempotency, and outbox ownership.
Defined short transactions, lock order, fencing, private storage recovery, token rotation, and backup restore behavior.
not_solved: No public API change or parent schema integration was authorized.

findings.claim: A standalone schema can implement the requested reference behavior without modifying parent files.

evidence_refs.observation: Explicit state, constraint, index, and PROTECT relationships are defined.
evidence_refs.supports: The isolated service owns only its execution facts.
evidence_refs.does_not_support: It does not prove compatibility with an unapproved production schema.

approved_decisions: Use only dependency versions already present in the parent backend requirements.

open_questions.resolution_needed: Decide whether admission before revocation permits the existing stream to continue.

next_stage_constraints: Reject unknown obligations; keep files private; never return input on failure.
authorization_remaining: Implement internal isolated contracts; do not attach parent routes.

stage: Stage 3 - protected artifact and execution pipeline

solved: Implemented signed authorization validation, binding, idempotent execution, leases/fences, CSV/XLSX transformation, private candidates, immutable artifact registration, receipts, and outbox facts.
not_solved: No real upstream authority, quota settlement, or remote object storage was connected.

findings.claim: Synthetic CSV/XLSX execution produces only a new validated private copy and rejects active/hidden XLSX channels.

evidence_refs.observation: Masking, projection, formula handling, hidden content, and hyperlinks were exercised.
evidence_refs.supports: Local transformation behavior for tested fixtures.
evidence_refs.does_not_support: Arbitrary real-world workbook compatibility or production scale.

approved_decisions: Use isolated HMAC adapter because no production authority wire contract was supplied.

open_questions.resolution_needed: Approve an adapter from parent ExecutionAuthorization to the signed payload.

next_stage_constraints: Only succeeded, integrity-verified artifacts can be shared.
authorization_remaining: Share implementation in isolated service only.

solved: Implemented recipient-bound shares, digest-only tokens, token rotation, expiry/revocation, admission locking, no-store streaming, delivery IDs, and evidence-aware delivery results.
not_solved: No email/SMS notification, presigned URL, external sink, or client-side anti-capture claim was added.

findings.claim: Token possession alone cannot authorize access and server stream completion is not recorded as client completion.

evidence_refs.observation: Recipient mismatch, token mismatch, expiry, revocation, rotation, distinct delivery IDs, and unknown stream result passed.
evidence_refs.does_not_support: Real identity provider, proxy buffering, or network interruption semantics.

approved_decisions: Evaluation mode is prohibited from creating shares.

open_questions.resolution_needed: Approve mapping between parent authenticated user IDs and recipient IDs.

next_stage_constraints: Do not describe server byte streaming as recipient persistence or reading.

stage: Stage 5 - integration, concurrency, and failure verification

solved: Ran syntax, Django checks, migration consistency, unit/behavior/contract/security tests, and local fencing/failure tests.
not_solved: Real PostgreSQL locking and all external integrations were unavailable.

findings.claim: The isolated test suite passes on SQLite while PostgreSQL-specific locking remains unverified.

evidence_refs.observation: All runnable tests passed and PostgreSQL test was explicitly skipped.
evidence_refs.supports: Local behavior and explicit verification gap.
evidence_refs.does_not_support: PostgreSQL isolation, lock wait, deadlock, or production readiness.

approved_decisions: Do not substitute SQLite results for PostgreSQL concurrency evidence.

open_questions.resolution_needed: Run the suite with a disposable target-version PostgreSQL database.

next_stage_constraints: Report readiness as partial, not production-ready.
authorization_remaining: Documentation, local commit, and attempted branch push.

solved: Prepared standalone run instructions, API boundary, verification record, failure matrix, recovery runbook, and rollback guidance.
not_solved: Production deployment, parent integration, and PR/merge were not authorized or performed.

findings.claim: The delivered artifact is independently reviewable and runnable without parent-file changes.

evidence_refs.observation: All implementation, configuration, migration, tests, fixtures, and documentation are contained in one new directory.
evidence_refs.does_not_support: Automatic integration with the parent application.

approved_decisions: No automatic deployment, PR, merge, or parent integration.

open_questions.resolution_needed: Use a GitHub account with push permission for Xiaodaidai-521/ctf.

next_stage_constraints: Any parent integration requires a separately authorized change because parent files are read-only in this task.
authorization_remaining: Commit only added files and attempt a normal non-force push.
